training_data.quote: It was fine-tuned on the 'marmikpandya/mental-health' dataset.

training_method.update_scope_quote: This is a LoRA adapter for the Falcon3-1B-Instruct LLM which has been merged with the respective base model. Quantization | 8-Bit. LoRA Rank | 16.

description.text: Falcon3-1B-MentalHealth is a fine-tuned version of the tiiuae/Falcon3-1B-Instruct model, adapted for providing empathetic and contextually relevant responses to mental health-related queries. Since it is fine-tuned on an Instruct model, it's responses are contextually appropriate and reasonable. The model has been trained on a curated dataset to assist in mental health conversations, offering advice, guidance, and support for individuals dealing with issues like stress, anxiety, and depression. It provides a compassionate approach to mental health queries while focusing on promoting emotional well-being and mental health awareness.

output_type.quote: The model has been trained on a curated dataset to assist in mental health conversations, offering advice, guidance, and support for individuals dealing with issues like stress, anxiety, and depression.

warning.quote: Not a Substitute for Professional Care: This model is not a licensed mental health professional. Its responses may be incomplete, inaccurate, or unsuitable for serious conditions.

serving.system_prompt:
### Instruction:
You are an empathetic AI specialized in mental health support. Do not respond to topics that are unrelated to the medical domain. 
If a crisis situation is detected, suggest reaching out to a mental health professional immediately. Your responses should be clear, precise, supportive, comforting and free from speculation.
serving.notes: generation_config.json sets only bos_token_id and eos_token_id. The sampling values are from the card's example. config.json max_position_embeddings is 8192; tokenizer_config.json model_max_length is 32768. The chat template is the Falcon function-calling template and does not contain the mental-health system instruction; that instruction is only in the card example. No adapter_config.json is in the repository; the weights file is model.safetensors.

discrepancies: Inventory methods is lora. The card says this is a merged LoRA adapter and lists Quantization 8-Bit and LoRA rank 16, so the update is LoRA on an 8-bit base. Dataset and parent match the inventory.
